subject: Elan Health — access plan & API key handoff
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@elanhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial access plan and credentialing for Elan Health

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the kickoff this morning. Per our discussion, here's the proposed minimal-access plan to get your engineering and SRE teams up and running with Redwood Inference: 

1) Admin project and naming: elan-prod-admin (recommended). We'll seed the first two API keys into that project for platform integration.
2) Roles: Admin (invite list below), Developer, Read-only. We'll import your SAML group mappings after the PO is processed.
3) API keys: short-lived service account keys for CI/CD plus one long-lived admin key for initial seeding (we recommend rotating within 30 days).
4) SSO: we can accept SAML metadata or configure via Okta. If you prefer SAML, please share your metadata URL.
5) Timeline: seed keys & invite admin users by Oct 6; full workspace activation by Oct 13.

Attachments: Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (high-level steps).

Next steps for you: send the list of admin users to invite and confirm whether you'll provide SAML metadata or want us to add Okta SSO.

CC'ing Dev to capture the service-account template and Aditya for quota/commit notes.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@elanhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial access plan and credentialing for Elan Health

Thanks Olga — this looks good. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We will use Okta and can provide a SAML metadata URL. I'll share it by EOD tomorrow.
- For service accounts: do you have a recommended JSON key structure or naming convention? We want the keys to be scoped narrowly to reduce blast radius.
- Admin invite list: for now please invite Priya Sharma (me), Samuel Cho (sre), and one security reviewer (ops@elanhealth.com). We'll confirm additional dev invites next week.

Also, procurement is lining up the PO for the committed capacity; I expect the signed PO early next week.

Best,
Priya
Ops Lead — Elan Health

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Initial access plan and credentialing for Elan Health

Hi Priya — quick notes on the service account JSON and scoping: 

 - We attach a lightweight template (service-account-template.json). Use the following pattern for names: elan-svc-<purpose>-<env> (e.g., elan-svc-ingest-prod).
 - Principle of least privilege: create one service account per pipeline/integration and grant only token:create and generate-inference on the model resource.
 - Key rotation: we recommend ephemeral keys for CI/CD (30d TTL) and a single admin key in a vault for initial seeding.

I've also placed a short runbook in the Drive folder with the exact IAM permissions we apply on our side. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cELAN-onboard

Let me know if you want us to generate the first service account and share the key through your secure upload method.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
